detail: Decisions: Chose to narrow superseded_count to superseded+overridden with archived counted solely by archived_excluded_count — supersedes the deliberate keep-the-name-widen-the-count choice, whose rationale (count only ever displayed, avoid breaking response shape) no longer holds now that field consumers read the counts programmatically for a hard gate and reported the archived double-count as a defect; the retired-status FILTER is unchanged, only the count partition
summary: Wave A: narrowed why()'s superseded_count to superseded+overridden — archived counted only by archived_excluded_count, ending the double-count the field flagged in D10.
